commit.message:
ref(celery): Remove partitioned queues (#39634)

Partitioned queues no more. Queues for `counters` and `triggers` weren't
really partitioned because `create_partitioned_queues` was looping over
`range(1)` so there were always only `counters-0` and `triggers-0`
(confirmed in
[metrics](https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/j6i-rfz-67y/queue-status?fullscreen_end_ts=1664992112394&fullscreen_paused=false&fullscreen_section=overview&fullscreen_start_ts=1664977712394&fullscreen_widget=87139323&from_ts=1664975117626&to_ts=1664989517626&live=true)).
This PR removes the partitioning logic.
